name: Divine Eminence
description: As a bonus action, the creature can expend a spell slot to cause its melee weapon attacks to magically deal an extra 10 (3d6) radiant damage to a target on a hit. This benefit lasts until the end of the turn. If the creature expends a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, the extra damage increases by 1d6 for each level above 1st.
